purpose: Saved-result robustness checks; not the final HW D.2 report
analysis_only: Read saved outputs; observational waveform and mass-accounting checks; conditional CDF validation; finite-sample and exploratory law-reweighting diagnostics
full_horizon_metric: Retain t=0 and all initial maxima. Secondary rain-response diagnostics never replace this metric.
uncertainty_scope: Separate fixed historical events; no event occurrence model; same 64 parameter IDs matched across events.
interpretation_limit: Mass-accounting differences do not identify causal effects of initial wetland water without a separate initial-condition experiment.
